environment.executionPolicy: RemoteSigned (CurrentUser scope); no policy bypass used

method.gate: launch-gate.mjs: hash-pinned launcher spawned with the CLI's exact stdio/cwd/environment; it joins the owned job through assign() and creates the CLI only after releaseGated() confirms membership, so the CLI's first code runs inside the job and its descendants join the same job. Abort marker, bounded wait, assignment failure, late assignment after cancellation and pre-release cancellation all end the launcher without creating the CLI.
method.whyNotSuspendedCreate: Node's spawn cannot pass CREATE_SUSPENDED, and having the helper create the CLI directly would move the wrapper-owned stdio pipes across a process boundary. The gate uses the job's native create-into-job semantics (job-owner.ps1 admits no breakaway; a member's child joins at creation) instead of suspend-assign-resume, with the same invariant: the target's first code runs only after membership.
method.controls: Deterministic delayed-assignment control (real owner, assign held back 500ms past node module top level) reproduced the pre-fix escape first, then passed with the gate. Module-top-level descendant control kept as the entry-level invariant; it passed pre-fix on real timing because the resident-helper assign roundtrip beats node bootstrap, which is timing dependence, not containment.
